sources.title: Models - MLX Audio
sources.snippet: Models MLX Audio supports a wide range of audio models across several categories, all optimized for Apple Silicon. Many hosted MLX checkpoints referenced in these docs live under mlx-community on Hugging Face, the shared org for ready-to-use MLX model weights across projects like mlx-lm, mlx-vlm, and mlx-audio.
